content.short: Moralis NFT API enables developers to fetch and index NFT data and metadata in real time.
content.description: The Moralis NFT API, launched in June 2021, enables real-time indexing of NFT data across blockchains. It sources and consolidates NFT balance, metadata, price, transfer history, ownership, and related data on a single platform to help developers build and scale NFT-focused decentralized applications. By unifying cross-chain NFT data, the API streamlines workflows and can reduce development time by up to 80% for NFT projects.
